calibration_rule: nearest 10ms of median Core input to first observed execution; proxy assumes zero local/exchange UTC offset, cancels uncalibrated at520ms; no tuning on holdout
passive_queue: displayed same-price size ahead; advances only on public opposing trades; unvalidated and excluded from a full fidelity PASS
covered_class: Every simulated order must fill completely against available-at fresh depth on arrival; no dropping adverse live/simulated groups
funding: public settled fundingHistory rate and last public oracle available before settlement <=2s old, signed truncation to1e-6 USDC, own simulated inventory at settlement
cash_gate: independent actual ledger vs Core/report and own simulated executions vs Core; not a promise of exact market-model PnL
first_run_guard: stop after15min on lifecycle failure or quantitative FAIL; retain INCONCLUSIVE and continue second frozen run; no retuning
